spec.name: Furniture Oak Dining Table
spec.description: A generous square oak dining table with five thick boards, four sturdy inset legs, and a connected recessed apron. Narrow board gaps, warm end grain, and painted pegged joints give it a cozy survival-built character. Fits within two Minecraft blocks square and one block tall.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: large square oak dining table with four sturdy legs. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..32; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
